violation_type.title: Doors Leading to Pool Area Locked (26 TAC §744.3407(c))
violation_type.short_title: Doors Leading to Pool Area Locked
violation_type.typical_finding: The door leading to the indoor pool used by children or as a pass-thu for using the outdoor pool does not have a required locking mechanism.

finding_variants.text: The door leading to the indoor pool used by children or as a pass-thu for using the outdoor pool does not have a required locking mechanism.
